html:
Unique Research · Ranking · October 12, 2024

Methodology note

CN package is board/chart-heavy (~20 images). EN below inventories every board and restates methodology so tables can be attached or redrawn on import. Rankings are September 2024 Unique Research composites over thousands of AI companies and ~10k products. Cite as【数据来源：非凡产研】; charts【数据来源：非凡产研，图表制作：非凡产研】. Not investment advice.

Board inventory

Global company

  • AI Company Unicorn TOP 100 — latest valuation, unlisted
  • AI Company Revenue TOP 100 — estimated annual revenue
  • AI Company Valuation Growth TOP 100 — daily average valuation increase

Global product

  • AI WEB Product TOP 100 — cumulative visits
  • AI WEB Stickiness TOP 100 — per-user visit duration
  • AI APP Product TOP 100 — cumulative downloads
  • AI APP Stickiness TOP 100 — per-user usage duration
  • AI APP IAP Revenue TOP 100 — in-app purchase only (excl. ads, direct pay, third-party Android)

China company & product

  • China AI Company Attention TOP 100 — sum visit duration across all AI WEB+APP products (Chinese / ethnic-Chinese founders, domestic or overseas entities)
  • China AI Product Coverage TOP 100 — combined WEB+APP MAU
  • Domestic AI WEB TOP 100 — China founders, China market, visits
  • Outbound AI WEB TOP 100 — Chinese / ethnic-Chinese founders, overseas market, visits
  • Domestic AI APP TOP 100 — downloads
  • Outbound AI APP TOP 50 — downloads

Data scope

Mixed market + Unique Research algorithms; labeled/classified by the research team. Counts PC/tablet/phone web & APP use only — excludes browser extensions, desktop software, mini-programs, Discord/third-party apps, local open-source runs. Universe: AI products with >10k monthly visits; analysis focuses on global / China / outbound TOP 30/50/100.

Geography & product types

Overseas = non-Chinese founders, global (incl. home) market. Domestic = Chinese founders, China market. Outbound = Chinese / ethnic-Chinese founders, primary market outside China.

AI-native = AI is the core value (product wouldn’t exist without it). AI-feature = AI bolted onto existing apps. AI-ecosystem = platforms connecting developers, providers, users.

Metric definitions (abridged)

WEB: Visits (session rules: 30-min idle / new day = new visit); Unique Visitors (unique IPs/month); Visit Duration (first→last action in a session).

APP: Downloads (store units); Sessions (opens; multi-open within 5s = one); Active Users (users with ≥1 activity in period); Duration Time (total time in app).

Attach or redraw all 14 boards (~20 images) on import.

— END —
